core_obligations: Translate V' into a finite type ideal I on V whose vanishing locus misses U cap V (proof lines 9135-9140).
Glue I with the unit ideal on U to an ideal I' on U cup V (proof lines 9140-9143).
Extend I' to a finite type ideal J on X and take its blowup (proof lines 9143-9147).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for quasi-compact quasi-separated X with quasi-compact open U, V and a U cap V-admissible blowup b : V' -> V, there is a U-admissible blowup X' -> X whose restriction to V is V' (source lines 9126-9133). The proof picks the finite type ideal I on V cutting out the blowup, glues it with the unit ideal on U to a sheaf I' on U cup V (using the gluing material for sheaves), and extends I' to a finite type ideal J on X by the extension lemma for finitely generated ideal sheaves; the blowup in J is the required X'.
